title: Holcim (Australia) Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Blackhead Concrete Services

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Holcim proposes to acquire  Blackhead Concrete Services - the pre-mixed concrete business in Taree South NSW.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed merger within the context of a regional market surrounding Taree for the supply of pre-mix concrete.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. Key factors informing this conclusion included: -there would remain a number of other pre-mix concrete suppliers post-acquisition, both within Taree and located to the south and north; and -there were relatively low barriers to new entry or expansion in the supply of pre-mix concrete within the Taree region.
